evaluation.notice: Notice: these results come from a scripted agent that replays fixed trajectories; no model was called. They measure harness mechanics only. Exercised for real: the context manager, the execution guard, the model router and the local decision policy (classification, strategy, escalation decisions). Scripted or reimplemented by the harness itself, not run through the orchestration engine: the attempt loop and retries, task scheduling and parallelism, and whether a step or a verification passes. No command is executed, and the engine's run and task flow, baselines, approvals, permission policy and verification engine are not exercised. Cost and duration are simulated units. The results are not evidence about the performance of any model or of the engine's orchestration. Scripted results say nothing about model quality, and tool-definition token figures are estimates from rough constants, not measurements.
evaluation.report.title: Scripted evaluation report
evaluation.report.label: Evidence label: {label}.
evaluation.report.units: Simulated cost: tokens in context at each step multiplied by a per-tier constant ({prices}). Simulated duration: one unit per scripted step, plus one unit when a plan is made. Neither is money or time.
evaluation.report.limits_text: Every outcome above is decided by the script, its conditions and the configuration. The tables hold raw counts and rates; differences between rows describe how the harness components reacted to the same fixed trajectory and say nothing about whether a configuration helps a model finish a task.
evaluation.task.empty_subtask: Subtask {subtask} has no step in the script.
evaluation.task.needs_criteria: Step {step} (verify) must name at least one criterion.
evaluation.task.criteria_not_verify: Step {step} ({kind}) names criteria, which only a verify step may do.
evaluation.task.outcome_not_allowed: Step {step} ({kind}) cannot declare a failing outcome; only command and verify steps can.
evaluation.task.repeat_not_allowed: Step {step} ({kind}) cannot repeat; only command and handoff steps can.
evaluation.task.flags_not_command: Step {step} ({kind}) sets 'polling' or 'flaky', which only a command step may do.
evaluation.task.needed_without_tokens: Step {step} is marked 'needed_later' but adds nothing to the context (tokens is 0).
evaluation.task.unverified_criterion: Criterion {criterion} is not supported by any verify step.
evaluation.task.bad_requirement: Step {step} requires {item} verbatim, but {item} is not an earlier 'needed_later' step of the same subtask.
evaluation.task.unused_needed: Step {step} is marked 'needed_later' but no later step of its subtask requires it.
evaluation.config.bad_thresholds: Config {id}: thresholds must satisfy 0 < elide_at < summarize_at <= 1.
evaluation.config.bad_counts: Config {id}: max_attempts and max_parallel must be at least 1, and min_elide_tokens and keep_recent must not be negative.
evaluation.config.bad_tier: Config {id}: fixed routing needs fixed_tier set to one of: {tiers}; policy routing must leave it empty.
evaluation.error.evals_dir: The evals directory was not found at {path}. It ships with the repository, not with the installed package; pass --tasks-dir and --configs.
evaluation.error.configs_shape: {source} must be an object with a non-empty 'configs' list and an optional 'defaults' object.
evaluation.error.unschedulable: Subtasks can never start (unknown or cyclic dependencies): {ids}.
evaluation.error.input: The harness needs at least one {what} and unique ids (duplicates: {ids}).
eval.help: Run the scripted evaluation harness (harness mechanics only; no model is called).
eval.list.help: List the eval tasks and the harness configurations.
eval.run.help: Run every selected task under every selected configuration and print or write the report.
eval.validate.help: Validate one eval task file against the schema and the consistency rules.
eval.arg.tasks_dir: Directory with eval task files. Defaults to evals/tasks in the repository.
eval.arg.configs: Harness configurations file. Defaults to evals/baselines/configs.json in the repository.
eval.arg.task: Id of a task to run (repeatable). Defaults to every task.
eval.arg.config: Id of a configuration to run (repeatable). Defaults to every configuration.
eval.arg.out: Write the report to this file instead of printing it.
eval.arg.task_file: Path of the eval task file to validate.
evaluation.report.tool_selection_text: Rows exist only for configurations with tool selection on. The script names the tool a step stands for; no tool is called. The tool-definition token columns above are sums of rough, hand-set constants per tool: estimates for comparison, not measurements for any model or client.
evaluation.cases.help: List and validate the scored cases under evals/cases.
evaluation.cases.list: List the cases and the digest of the case set.
evaluation.cases.validate: Check every case file and the files it lists.
evaluation.cases.id_mismatch: the id {id!r} must match the file name
evaluation.cases.path_escape: the path {path!r} leaves the case folder
evaluation.cases.file_missing: the listed file {path!r} is missing from the case folder
evaluation.cases.uncommitted: The case set under evals/cases has uncommitted or untracked changes; commit them first.
evaluation.cases.status_failed: Could not check the case set with git (not a repository, git missing, timeout or error); the pin cannot be trusted.
evaluation.workspace.base_missing: Case {id}: the base commit {commit} does not exist in this repository.
evaluation.workspace.add_failed: Case {id}: could not create the workspace: {error}
evaluation.cases.at_base: Also run each check at its base commit; every check must fail there.
evaluation.cases.passes_at_base: These cases pass at their base commit, so they prove nothing: {ids}
evaluation.workspace.symlink: Case {id}: {path!r} would be written through a symlink in the workspace; refused.
evaluation.cases.check_broken: These checks could not run to a verdict (timed out or failed to start): {ids}
evaluation.scoring.no_cases: No case under evals/cases applies to this specialist; there is nothing to score
evaluation.scoring.over_cap: This pass would use {planned} agent runs and lesson requests, over the cap of {cap} (specialists.score_max_runs); nothing was run. Lower score_samples or the number of lessons, or raise the cap
evaluation.scoring.cases_changed: The case set changed while scoring; no lesson was decided
evaluation.scoring.agent_failed: The agent failed on case {case} ({error}); nothing was decided
evaluation.scoring.git_config_changed: The repository's .git/config changed while scoring; nothing was decided
evaluation.scoring.bad_history: A line of the score history is not valid JSON
evaluation.scoring.agent_timed_out: The agent timed out before finishing; the check was not run.
